CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  (Notice No. N2M25-97)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a special meeting of the Alhambra Civil Service Commission
will be held on Tuesday, July 22, 2025, commencing at 4:30 p.m. in the Conference Room A
of the Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California pursuant to Section
54956 of the Government Code of the State of California.

An agenda of such special meeting is attached hereto incorporated herein by reference and made
a part hereof as though fully set forth herein.

  MARIAM LEE KO
  Director of Human Resources & Risk Management
  Ex-Officio Member, Civil Service Commission

Dated:  July 17, 2025
Notice No.  N2M25-97
   CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  AGENDA
  ALHAMBRA CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  SPECIAL MEETING
  July 22, 2025 at 4:30 PM

  Alhambra City Hall
  Conference Room A – 2nd Floor of City Hall
  111 South First Street
  Alhambra, CA 91801

In compliance with the Americans with Disability Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this
meeting, please contact Mariam Ko, Director of Human Resources & Risk Management (626) 570-5095.
Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure
accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35. 102-35.104 ADA Title II). All public records relating to an
agenda item on this agenda are available for the public inspection at the time the records are distributed
to all, or a majority of all, members of the Civil Service Commission. Such records shall be available at
City Hall located at 111 South First Street.

ROLL CALL:  HATEM, KAN, LIEBERG, PLASCENCIA, TELLEZ-GAGLIANO

  April 14, 2025
  6:30 p.m.

I.  CALL TO ORDER: At 6:37 p.m., on Monday, April 14, 2025, the Alhambra Civil Service
  Commission met in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall.

  ROLL CALL:
  PRESENT:  HATEM, KAN, LIEBERG, PLASCENCIA, TELLEZ-GAGLIANO

  Service Commission Attorney Scott Campbell

REPORT - NOTICE NO. N2M25-41
The Director of Human Resources & Risk Management reported that she duly gave notice of the
special meeting of the Alhambra Civil Service Commssion being held this evening pursuant to and in
accordance with Section 54956 of the Government Code of the State of California.

II. PUBLIC COMMENT
  NONE.

III. COMMISSIONER ORIENTATION
  Commission Attorney Scott Campbell delivered a presentation and provided orientation to the Civil
  Service Commission. A copy of the presentation is attached to the agenda packet posted publicly.

  Discussion:  None.

  Action Taken:  The Commission received and ordered filed this informational report.

  None.

V. ADJOURNMENT: At 7:40 p.m. there being no further business for the Commission to transact,
  with the consent of the Commission, the meeting was adjourned.

III. ELECTION OF A CHAIRPERSON AND VICE CHAIRPERSON

  Action Taken: Commissioner Lieberg was elected Chair of the Commission.

  Vote:  Moved:  PLASCENCIA  Seconded: TELLEZ-GAGLIANO
  Ayes:  HATEM, KAN, PLASCENIA, TELLEZ-GAGLIANO
  Noes:  NONE
  Abstain:  LIEBERG

  Action Taken: Commission Kan was elected as Vice Chair of the Commission.

  Vote:  Moved:  KAN  Seconded: TELLEZ-GAGLIANO
  Ayes:  HATEM, KAN, LIEBERG, PLASCENCIA, TELLEZ-GAGLIANO
  Noes:  NONE
  Abstain:  NONE

IV. APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF APRIL 14, 2025

  Action Taken:  Approval of April 14, 2025 Minutes by the Commission.

  Vote:  Moved:  PLASCENCIA  Seconded: KAN

  Noes:  NONE
  Abstain:  NONE
   V. CLOSED SESSION:

  Attorney Campbell identified the two items on this evening’s agenda which would be
  discussed in Closed Session as follows:

  A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINE/DISMISSAL/RELEASE
  B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE DISCIPLINE/DISMISSAL/RELEASE

  whereaupon at 6:22 p.m. the Civil Service Commission moved into Closed Session pursuant
  to applicable law for the purpose of conferring with the Attorney.

RECONVENE & ATTORNEY REPORT: At 6:56 p.m. the Civil Service Commission moved out of
closed session
with all members present. Attorney Campbell reported one reportable action on one of the appeals.
Attorney Campbell reported that the City did accept the termination of the civil service proceeding
that was abandoned by an appellant.

VI. ORAL COMMUNICATION (CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION ONLY)
  None.

ADJOURNMENT:  At 6:57 p.m. there being no further business for the Civil Service Commission
to transact, Chairman Lieberg, with the consent of the Civil Service Commission, adjourned the
meeting.

  MARIAM LEE KO,
  DIRECTOR OF HUMAN RESOURCES & RISK
